intent: REFACTOR BroadcastingService: inspect the implementation for layering violations, blocking calls, unbounded buffers, hardcoded values and invariant gaps; improve clarity without changing the public surface or breaking tests. Spec: Telemetry Stream Broadcasting use case implementing BroadcastTelemetryUseCase. Constructor BroadcastingService(TelemetryStreamGateway gateway, BoundedEventChannel<TelemetryStreamPublishedEvent> streamPublications, Clock clock). broadcastSample/broadcastWindow map to BroadcastItem, publish through the gateway, then publish TelemetryStreamPublishedEvent(kind, deviceId, sampleCount, clock.instant()); a failure publishing that audit event is swallowed (onErrorResume) so it never blocks broadcasting. stream(deviceId) = gateway.items() filtered by deviceId when non-null. Broadcasting never influences ordering.
